note: Final acceptance settings, unchanged from the M1 development audit: each tool runs its identical-constraints configuration and its own best native configuration; the gate uses the better per job. Configuration files are pinned by their LF-normalised SHA-256.

nestbolt.note: Nestbolt's identical-constraints and best settings are the same defaults, so each slot runs once.

execution_note: batch_size and planning_overhead_seconds are execution parameters, not tool settings. A session starts a batch only if count x (budget + planning_overhead_seconds) still fits before its deadline; each runner keeps its own stricter worst-case guard. The first final session began with 24-run SVGnest and single-run Deepnest batches.
